DARV.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.0-0.an: A big star like you visiting my humble shop? I doubt there's much I can offer you... Just kidding. Have a look through that pile.
DARV.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1-0r.a: That young lady who's always with you seems more interested in my collection?
DARV.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1-1r.c: Miss Mio probably knows more about these things than I do.
DARV.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2-0r.a: You look well-prepared. Got any collectibles you'd be willing to part with? I promise you won't lose out.
DARV.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2-1r.c: Huh? Not really... I'm actually pretty broke.
VAKUU.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.0-1.c: Eek! D-don't come any closer! I-I'm not afraid of you!
That young lady over there, no need to glare at me like that. This is just a fair trade.
(Miss Mio's hand is already on her sword hilt...)
You have long understood the weight of a contract.
TEZCATARA.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.0: Ah, two adorable little guests! Come, have some snacks with Tezcatara!
Isn't it a little too hot in here...?
TEZCATARA.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1: Reminds me of the candied apples I had as a child. They were so sweet.
TEZCATARA.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2: Anything that tries to exploit you should be [jitter]burned[/jitter] without hesitation.
PAEL.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.0-0.ch: She seems to be sleeping so peacefully... I hope a Bubble can bring her a pleasant dream.
PAEL.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1-0r.c: I once read about the legend of the "Aragami" in Higashinese history.
PAEL.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1-1r.a: An immortal, indestructible god... Sadly, I am not nearly so powerful.
PAEL.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2-0r.a: May a part of me be of help to you.
PAEL.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2-1r.c: Severed fingers aren't exactly unheard of in Higashi... but I still find it hard to accept that this is a part of you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.0: Ah! Two elegant, beautiful little visitors! Let me adorn you both properly!
NONUPEIPE.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1: Your Bubbles and your performances complement each other perfectly!
Thank you very much for your kind words...
NONUPEIPE.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2: A few sequins here, a few accessories there... I'll make you both absolutely dazzling!
[i][font_size=22](Mio waves her hand apologetically. She may not be used to such elaborate decorations.)[/font_size][/i]
OROBAS.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1-0r: Concerts are good! Singing, applause, heartbeats!
OROBAS.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1-1r: If I get the chance, I wouldn't mind holding a concert here in the Spire.
OROBAS.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2-0r: A fireworks show! I can't wait!
OROBAS.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2-1r: Yes, but the fireworks show I remember most was an unusually simple one.
TANX.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.0-0.an: [b]FISH AND BIRD! SO FRAGILE! TRY THIS WEAPON![/b]
TANX.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.1-0r.a: [b]BUBBLES AND BLADES! WEAPONS FOR OFFENSE AND DEFENSE![/b]
TANX.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2-0r.a: [b]THREE-HANDED WOMAN! FIGHT ME! NO HOLDING BACK![/b]
TANX.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARUKA.2-1r.c: [i][font_size=22]Haruka notices a faint smile flash across Mio's face.[/font_size][/i]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.HARUKA_CHARACTER_HARU: This is no place for your concert.
Then you'd better be ready for the consequences.
